description: Manual laps of one workout as a compact table plus training-load fields: how to read a guided gym session back set by set (push_strength_guide records a lap per set and per rest; push_workout_guide one per exercise and rest; push_interval_guide auto-advances and is expected, unverified, to record none). ~2.5 KB for 35 laps. Result: guide, tss, pte, peakEpoc, recoveryTime (units not verified), hrZoneTimeS, feeling, lapCount, checks, laps {cols, rows}. checks lists reasons not to trust positional reading: duplicate-rest, no-session-complete (ended early or watch restarted), unlabelled-laps, no-heart-rate. kind: rest (label has 'Next:'), done (final 'Session complete'), step or null. A per-set strength guide gives per exercise a prep lap, then set, rest, set, rest, ...; prep and set labels look alike, so use position and check labels, not just counts. No manual laps: lapCount 0, not an error.

workoutKey.description: 24-hex id from list_workouts; anything else fails with not-found without calling Suunto.
